### Event Rules for Participants  
* Participants must follow Event Staff instructions.  
* Participants should park at their designated slots.  
* Convoy participants must only leave the starting location when instructed to do so in an orderly (one by one) manner.
* Participants must haul a trailer during the convoy. 
* Double trailers, Triple trailers, HCT trailers and Heavy Haul configurations are prohibited.
* Cars including alternating vehicles are prohibited except for TruckersMP Event Staff assisting with the event. 
* Buses are prohibited.
* Overtaking is strictly prohibited.  
* Free roaming on the server is prohibited.
* All Other TruckersMP Rules Apply.  

### Event Rules for Event Staff  
* Event Staff can block junctions and roads approaching junctions in order to direct the convoy.  
* Event Staff can park out of bounds. Providing this is on the ground and not on top of buildings or other inappropriate places deemed unsuitable by TruckersMP Staff.  
* All Other **[TruckersMP Rules](https://truckersmp.com/rules)** Apply.

## Welcome to the event!
### This November, Ponc Logistics X TurkishLine is hitting the road for a special ATS convoy, taking us from Elko Garage to Hilt Bitumen.
### Our journey will begin in the desert roads of Elko, surrounded by wide open landscapes and classic American highways. As we continue toward Hilt, drivers will experience a mix of long roads, scenic routes, and relaxing views across the western states.
### This convoy promises a calm yet enjoyable drive, bringing together our drivers for a memorable American Truck Simulator experience. Whether you are joining for the scenery, the road, or the community spirit, this route will offer a great time for everyone.
### As always, our CC team will be present throughout the convoy to ensure a safe, smooth, and enjoyable journey for all participants.

today.name: Wortex Group Company — 1st Anniversary Convoy
today.description:
Dear TruckersMP Community and Fellow Drivers,

We are immensely proud and thrilled to officially announce the **Wortex Group Company 1st Anniversary Convoy**! It has been an incredible year filled with miles of open roads, strong friendships, and a rapidly growing family.

To celebrate this major milestone in true trucking fashion, we have meticulously mapped out a magnificent long-haul route that promises an exceptional driving experience. For this grand celebration, we have reserved **44 dedicated slot areas** for our guest Virtual Trucking Companies (VTCs). We would be deeply honored to have you on the road with us on this special day!

---

![](https://i.imgur.com/xFySu4L.png)

> * Date : 17.11.2026 / Tuesday 
> * Meetup Time : 17:00 UTC- 20:00 TSİ
> * Departure   : 18:00 UTC - 21:00 TSİ
> * Server      : Event Server

---

![](https://i.imgur.com/clRIH7K.png)

> * Start Location : Hannover (Slot Areas / Companies)
> * Destination    : Mannheim (SteinBruch Company)
> * Distance       : 1.110 km

> Our convoy will depart from the assigned slot areas in the heart of Germany, Hannover. After eating up the asphalt for approximately 1,110 kilometers across wide highways and scenic stretches, we will wrap up our event with an exciting and technical parking finale at the steep, winding roads of the **SteinBruch** quarry in **Mannheim**.

![](https://i.imgur.com/X6XzdC5.jpeg)

**Note: The original route has been added to the page to help you better understand the event route.**

---

![](https://i.imgur.com/na6NXke.png)

> * Public Parking Area      : Hannover - Garage

![](https://i.imgur.com/wBgZ8q2.jpeg)

upcoming.rule:
Konvoi Regeln

Überholen im Konvoi
Während des gesamten Konvois ist das Überholen im Konvoi untersagt.
Ausnahmen bildet das Eventteam, die absicherungsfima und das Filmteam.
Während der Startaufstellung und in der Pause ist das Überholen zur eigenen Spedition erlaubt.


Sicherheitsabstand
Um einem Crash oder Ziehharmonikaeffekt vorzubeugen, haltet einen Sicherheitsabstand von 100-150 Metern ein.

Stillstand des Konvois
Sollte der Konvoi zum Stehen kommen, sind die Warnblinker einzuschalten.

Geschwindigkeit
Die Geschwindigkeit der konvoispitze wird im Discord unter Voice-Konvoi Channel vom Veranstalter an die Speditionen durchgegeben.

Ampeln
Ampeln können im Konvoi bei Rot überfahren werden, wenn nicht mit Gegen,- und/oder Querverkehr zu rechnen ist.

Werbung
Das Werben für die eigene Spedition ist während des ganzen Konvois verboten!

Trailer
Die Teilnahme an einem Konvoi erfolgt mit einem Trailer, auf den sich die dreifarbige Firmenlackierung aufbringen lässt (z.B. gurtainsider, Isoliert, Gekühlt, Trockenfrachtkoffer, Lebensmitteltank, Kipper). Ausnahmen werden vor dem Konvoi bekanntgegeben.

Anwesenheit
Spätestens 15 Minuten vor Beginn des Konvois sind alle Teilnehmer auf dem Event-DC anwesend und haben ingame den LKW repariert und voll getankt.
